subtheme: Learning from unlabeled data without labels

subsubthemes.name: Finding similar patterns in data without labels
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that learn by comparing examples to find which ones look alike or are related, using similarity scores to guide learning without any human labels.

subsubthemes.name: Predicting hidden parts of data to learn representations
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that hide parts of data (like masking words or patches) and train models to fill in the blanks, building understanding through reconstruction.

subsubthemes.name: Learning from multiple types of information together
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that combine information from different sources (like images and text, or video and audio) to learn richer representations without labels.

subsubthemes.name: Making predictions more robust and stable
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that improve contrastive learning and representation stability through calibration, temperature scaling, or handling difficult examples more carefully.

subsubthemes.name: Organizing data into meaningful groups
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that cluster unlabeled data or find underlying structure by identifying natural groups and relationships without human guidance.

subsubthemes.name: Learning patterns that work in new situations
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that train models to learn representations flexible enough to transfer to different domains or handle data that changes at test time.

subsubthemes.name: Improving learning efficiency with less data
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that make self-supervised learning faster or more efficient through federated approaches, sparse models, or better sample selection strategies.
